BrochureContent.Content: Oates Breheny Group proudly present 5 Quay View, Mullaghmore, an impressive four-bedroom detached home enjoying breathtaking coastal views in the picturesque and renowned seaside village of Mullaghmore. From the moment you enter, this beautiful home offers a wonderful sense of light and space. A tiled entrance hall leads through to the generous open-plan kitchen, living and dining area, creating a bright and inviting space at the heart of the home. The fully fitted kitchen features a central island and integrated appliances. In the living space, a contemporary stove is seamlessly integrated into a central feature wall, creating an inviting centrepiece to the room. An abundance of windows frame the spectacular coastal surroundings and allow natural light to flow throughout, while the adjoining dining area benefits from patio doors opening directly onto the rear patio, providing an ideal setting for outdoor dining. The ground floor also comprises a utility room, a generous bedroom with its own en suite, and a further bedroom with direct access to the shared bathroom. Upstairs, there are two additional bedrooms, one of which benefits from its own en suite, completing the spacious and versatile accommodation. Externally, the property is equally impressive. A brick-paved driveway provides ample off-street parking, while manicured lawns, mature hedging and established palm trees enhance the home's wonderful coastal character. No. 5 occupies an attractive position within a small development of just 20 homes and is further tucked away within a quiet cul-de-sac. One of the property's greatest attractions is its superb location. Mullaghmore Village is just a downhill walk away, where residents can enjoy local shops, cafés and hotels, together with the village's picturesque pier, harbour and renowned beach. Steeped in history and internationally recognised for its spectacular coastline and world-class surfing, Mullaghmore remains one of the North-West's most desirable coastal destinations. The property is also just a short drive from Cliffoney Village and less than 15 minutes from both Grange and Bundoran, offering an excellent combination of peaceful coastal living and everyday convenience. With generous accommodation, beautiful surroundings and breathtaking coastal views, 5 Quay View presents a wonderful opportunity to own a home in the heart of Mullaghmore. To arrange a viewing of this beautiful property, please contact Oates Breheny Group on 071 914 0404.
